source: systematic review of small-chain execution router fail-closed findings

environment.recent_head: 2311b4c chore: align skill team orchestration with TeamCreate

issues.summary: Plan-stage hook allowed continuation when execution-routing-input.json was missing.
issues.observed: RED: bash tests/test-small-chain-execution-router-hook.sh failed with output {} and missing expected "continue": false.

hypotheses.name: Hook never invokes router when a plan-stage artifact is missing.
hypotheses.evidence: shared/hooks/managed/small_chain_execution_router.py:141 now gates only on worklog mode/stage; the removed artifact-existence gate caused fail-open.

hypotheses.name: Router cannot produce a blocked route for missing artifacts.

issues.root_cause: Hook ownership was too broad: it decided whether missing route artifacts should allow continuation instead of delegating the failure contract to the router.
issues.fix: Changed hook routing eligibility to plan-stage worklog only, so missing tasks/plan/input is handled by router blocked output.

issues.summary: Router approved route task IDs that did not exist in tasks.md or plan.md.
issues.observed: RED: bash tests/test-small-chain-execution-router.sh failed at unknown route task id should return non-zero.

hypotheses.name: parse_tasks validates only routing-input internal references.
hypotheses.evidence: tools/community/small_chain_execution_router.py:115 parses routing JSON; tools/community/small_chain_execution_router.py:172 now performs the missing cross-artifact validation.

hypotheses.name: tasks.md and plan.md parser cannot identify task IDs.
hypotheses.evidence: tools/community/check_task_plan_consistency.py already parses the same Markdown task ID grammar.

issues.root_cause: Route input was not bound to the small-chain source-of-truth artifacts, so an internally valid JSON task list could drift from tasks.md/plan.md.
issues.fix: Added task_ids_from_tasks, task_ids_from_plan, and validate_task_scope before any route decision.

issues.summary: A stale route could become usable after a second ordinary router run.
issues.observed: Pre-fix review reproduction showed stale-first=blocked and stale-second=parallel.

hypotheses.name: Blocked stale route was written with current hashes, so the next run saw a fresh route.
hypotheses.evidence: tools/community/small_chain_execution_router.py:341 checks stale route state before decision; tools/community/small_chain_execution_router.py:284 now keeps stale_existing_execution_route blocked until force refresh.

hypotheses.name: The hash algorithm was unstable.
hypotheses.evidence: The same route input and normalized tasks hash remain stable across repeated passing router tests.

issues.root_cause: Stale detection treated a stale-blocked execution-route.json as an ordinary fresh route on the next invocation.
issues.fix: stale_existing_route now blocks any existing stale_existing_execution_route until --force-refresh is used.
issues.verification: GREEN: bash tests/test-small-chain-execution-router.sh passed and asserts the second stale run remains blocked.

issues.summary: Hook selected the first active small-chain entry rather than the current workset.
issues.observed: Review traced load_active_small_chain returning the first managed small-chain entry regardless of cwd.

hypotheses.name: Registry selection ignores hook cwd.
hypotheses.evidence: shared/hooks/managed/small_chain_execution_router.py:150 now selects by cwd match before falling back to a unique plan-stage workset.

hypotheses.name: Multiple active entries are impossible under the context contract.
hypotheses.evidence: The validator allows multiple managed feature paths; the new hook test builds two active entries.

issues.root_cause: Hook target selection relied on registry order instead of an execution context signal.
issues.fix: Added load_active_small_chains, cwd-relative matching, and ambiguous multi-plan blocking.
issues.verification: GREEN: bash tests/test-small-chain-execution-router-hook.sh passed and asserts docs/second is selected.

issues.summary: touches_contract_grade was parsed but not enforced by parallel safety checks.
issues.observed: RED: bash tests/test-small-chain-execution-router.sh failed at contract-grade route should return non-zero.

hypotheses.name: Contract-grade files are always caught by high-risk path prefixes.
hypotheses.evidence: The RED fixture used non-high-risk src paths with touches_contract_grade=true and was approved before the fix.

issues.root_cause: A safety fact in routing input was modeled but not consumed by the conservative V1 parallel gate.
issues.fix: Added touches_contract_grade blocking for requested parallel routes.

issues.summary: Unreadable existing execution-route.json could be overwritten as router_unavailable and then bypassed on a second run.
issues.observed: RED: bash tests/test-small-chain-execution-router.sh failed at missing unreadable route block.

hypotheses.name: stale_existing_route lets JSON parse errors escape to main.
hypotheses.evidence: tools/community/small_chain_execution_router.py:278 now catches unreadable existing routes and returns existing_route_unreadable.

hypotheses.name: The route file is not read during stale checks.
hypotheses.evidence: tools/community/small_chain_execution_router.py:281 reads the existing route before comparing hashes.

issues.root_cause: Malformed existing route files were handled by the top-level router_unavailable fallback rather than the stale/fail-closed route contract.
issues.fix: Caught unreadable existing route files inside stale_existing_route and converted them to a stale_existing_execution_route block.
issues.verification: GREEN: bash tests/test-small-chain-execution-router.sh passed and asserts the unreadable route remains blocked on a second run.
